docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-04-2026 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MILLER, ROCIO IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT PENINGTON, ALAN NOTHING. THE PLAINTIFFS' ALLEGATIONS WERE REFUTED BY THE DEFENDANT WITH CREDIBLE EVIDENCE. PLAINTIFF FAILED TO MEET HER BURDEN OF PROOF APPLICABLE IN SMALL CLAIM COURT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $12,500.00 FILED BY MILLER, ROCIO AS TO DEFENDANT PENINGTON, ALAN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-18-2026 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
REQUEST PENDING TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF MILLER, ROCIO
ORDER GRANTING WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52 AS TO PLAINTIFF MILLER, ROCIO
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVICE FEE: $50.00 (WAIVED) SERVED JAN-30-2026, PERSONAL SERVICE, NO SERVICE FEE AS TO DEFENDANT PENINGTON, ALAN
ORDER TO CONTINUE PER PLAINTIFF REQUEST

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-18-2026 - DUE TO THE CONDITION OF THE COURT'S CALENDAR THIS MATTER IS CONTINUED ON COURT'S OWN MOTION TO APR-13-2026 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ROCIO MILLER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ALAN PENNINGTON IS PRESENT. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. ***PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS LEFT IN COURTROOM.*** CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-04-2026 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-04-2026 BY MURLENE J. RANDLE. PLAINTIFF ROCIO MILLER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ALAN PENINGTON IS PRESENT. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE.
